title: Loopkeeper Verification Record (Schema 1)
description: Caller-attested verification record for manifest trust. Uses canonical manifest SHA-256, HMAC-SHA256 signature, and key selected by key_id from protected LOOPKEEPER_TRUST_KEY_FILE. Signature comparison is constant-time. Path to key file comes only from environment/CLI, never manifest.

method.description: Signature method. Only hmac-sha256 is supported.

key_id.description: Key identifier selected from protected key file.

manifest_sha256.description: Canonical manifest digest: SHA-256 over canonical UTF-8 JSON sorted keys compact separators plus trailing newline after removing trust.verification.
